definitions.explanation: Successfully completing or carrying out a task, duty, or mission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂行|すいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂行|すいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To have the ability to execute a plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧{遂行|すいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: To devote full effort to carrying out one's duties.

notes:
{遂行|すいこう} means to carry out or execute a task, duty, or plan to completion. It's formal and emphasizes successful accomplishment.

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business, military, and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂行|すいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to carry out a mission
- ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧{遂行|すいこう}: performance of duties
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂行|すいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to execute a plan
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{遂行|すいこう}: carrying out operations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧: execution (more general)
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧: achievement (focus on reaching goals)
- {遂行|すいこう}: execution (formal, focus on carrying through)

FORMS:
{遂|すい} (accomplish) + {行|こう} (carry out) = execution/accomplishment
